sloka: लक्ष्मणेमां माया सार्धं प्रशाधि त्वं वसुन्धराम् ।द्वितीयं मेऽन्तरात्मानं त्वामियं श्रीरुपस्थिता ॥२-४-४३॥
transliteration: lakṣmaṇemāṁ māyā sārdhaṁ praśādhi tvaṁ vasundharām ।dvitīyaṁ me'ntarātmānaṁ tvāmiyaṁ śrīrupasthitā ॥2-4-43॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus to Lakshmana, Rama saluted his mothers, took leave of Sita, and went to his own dwelling.
